description:
ZNH-02 Classic Adult City Commuter E-Bike
ZNH-02 is a Class 2 electric bike built for daily urban travel. Fits riders 5'2'' to 6'3''. Sleek all-black design, ideal for commuting, grocery runs and casual city rides.

500W Motor & Removable 36V 10Ah Battery
Powered by a 500W brushless hub motor with a max speed of 20MPH. The removable 36V 10Ah lithium battery is UL2849 compliant. It takes 3–4 hours to fully charge, delivering 24–37 miles on throttle mode and up to 50–60 miles on pedal assist mode for daily commutes.

Comfort Riding Setup
Front suspension fork softens bumps and reduces fatigue.
7-speed derailleur handles hills and varied road conditions.
LED display shows speed, battery and assist level in real time.
Ergonomic saddle and non-slip pedals for long rides.

Durable Construction
High-strength steel frame supports up to 330 LBS.
26" × 1.95 tires with thick double-wall aluminum rims, wear-resistant.
Net weight 67 LBS, easy to park and store.
Waterproof wiring for light rainy-day commuting.

Great Commuter Choice & Gift
Compact, comfortable and affordable. It is a great alternative to cars and public transit, and a nice gift for commuters and cycling lovers.

Important Notes
This is a Class 2 ebike. Please follow local state ebike regulations.
Range varies with weight, load, terrain and temperature.
Assembly required. Professional installation recommended for safety.
